text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt...!!
I'm the one who's gonna winnnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Kitasan, Black.........!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a festival, a festival! Yodo is a festival!
It's a Kitasan Festival~!
First across the wire is Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Classic Triple Crown! Claimed through sheer sheer determination!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I wonーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan!!
Congratulations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan...!
I won!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is who I am...!
I am—Kitasan Black!!
(Waaaaaah...!!)

Duramente stood in dazed disbelief after her defeat...
Unable to bear seeing her like this, and at a loss for words—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me.
Thank you—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Distance or whatever else, there are no excuses.
I was defeated... That is all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...She was different from the Kitasan up until now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
From her sheer intensity, to everything else...
...And on top of that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Kitasan...!
Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Your reckless running... your sheer dedication...
I was so moved!!
I'll be cheering for you from now on—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaan Blaaaack~~~~!!
Congratulatiooons--!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
Alright, bring it on!!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I will have my revenge one day.
I'll take that title back from the strongest Umamusume."
choice_data_list: We'll be rivals next year too!
We'll be rivals next year too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If we're talking about next year, there are far more important things to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Though I was defeated, physically, I am fine.
In my current condition, I can still challenge them.
choice_data_list: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I shall carve a new hoofprint into my clan's history.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is in the autumn.
I'd like to run in a few races before then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What is your idea?
choice_data_list: I was thinking about the "Nakayama Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see.
With your sights set on overseas racing, huh?

Many Umamusume who run in the Nakayama Kinen are aiming for overseas races.
The experience gained there should lead straight to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I agree.
Let's make our next goal the Nakayama Kinen.

With all our business finished, I walked Duramente
back to the dorms... where Fuji Kiseki was cleaning.

Not from the Miho Dormitory where Duramente lives...
but the dorm leader of the other one, the Ritto Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Duramente.
How was the race?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I lost to Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see.
She's been working really hard all this time, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, you worked hard, too.
Good job out there for today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Our dorms may be different, but we're still students of the same academy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Besides... I feel a kind of kinship with you, for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Something... close?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My mother is a stage actress, you see.
She gives people dreams through the stage."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—An overwhelming, unreal performance!
A thrilling, dreamlike stage!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Captivating people's hearts with an unforgettable brilliance... Doesn't that sound like a certain someone?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Your Trainer is quite straightforward, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Duramente's aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If she can pull off a victory...
it would rewrite common sense itself."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That sounds
super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Both as Fuji-senpai the dorm head... and as myself, I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the future you'll carve out.
Please, show many more girls what it means to dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, welcome back, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good luck!
See you later.
(Pat pat)

Fuji Kiseki gave Duramente a gentle pat on the head
and went to greet another Umamusume
who seemed to have just returned from self-training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's warm.
choice_data_list: A lot of people are cheering for us, huh
A lot of people are cheering for us, aren't they

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I've only ever thought about
living up to my clan's expectations, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to next year.
Let's redouble our training efforts toward our next target race, the Nakayama Kinen.
